description: Core Governance is the central organisation of the Powers Protocol Federation. It holds the main treasury (the Powers contract itself, in test USDC), funds development and audits of the core protocol, and distributes funding downstream to the Mandates organisation. Core draws a recurring income stream from the Endowment and, as an organisation, can veto new Endowment investments. Core also owns and funds the single central PowersPaymaster that sponsors gasless participation across all three federation organisations. Elected Core Members govern spending; an elected Security Council holds a narrow, reversible emergency pause and a reform veto.
